observation.visible_scene: A still-life interior shot: a glossy yellow-orange mug sits on a reddish-pink saucer on a bright white reflective tabletop in the right foreground. The mug's handle points left. Behind it, a dark sofa spans the frame, draped with two red/pink pillows (one each side) and an open book resting on the seat. A string of small warm lights (candle-like bulbs) is scattered across the sofa back and seat, with their bright reflections mirrored on the glossy table surface. On the left stands a floor lamp with a pale shade, and a framed abstract painting hangs on the light-blue wall above the sofa center.

The table reflections of the lights and the cup/saucer shadow stay in fixed positions, indicating neither object movement nor camera movement.
The scene is effectively a static interval for the entire excerpt.
